17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 6506-12 North California Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | RT-4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 21,652.1 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to establish a uniform zoning district and
construct a new two-story religious assembly building that will contain
approximately 15,508 sq. ft. of floor area. The proposed building will
measure 29 ft.-10 in. in height. The subject property is a Transit Served
Location and will be supported by thirty-five (35) off-street surface parking
spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment
and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1101-B and 17-13-1003-EE of
the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear
setback from the required 50 ft. to 6 fi.-11 in., reduce the front setback,
reduce the side setback, increase the off-street parking from the required
twenty-three (23) parking spaces to thirty-five (35) parking spaces, and is
seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the Code, for the attached plans.

(A) | The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 15,530 square feet (0.72 FAR)
(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 35 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Devon CTA Bus Line
Corridor roadway segment). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking
to increase the required number of off-street parking spaces from twenty-three (23)
parking spaces to thirty-five (35) parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 86 feet-5.5 inches
db. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 3 feet-3.25 inches
West Side: 3 feet
c. Rear Setback: 6 feet-11 inches

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front, side, and
rear setbacks.

(E) Building Height: 29 ft.-10 inches
